answer_1.quote: We propose a novel approach, TRACER (Target-oriented e‑commerce dialogue generation...), to simulate shopping conversations between two LLM agents... Our contributions... Release of Wizard‑of‑Shopping (WoS) dataset which includes 3.6k shopping conversations... The generated dialogues are highly natural and coherent...
answer_1.outputs: synthetic shopping dialogues, conversational queries, ranked product lists

answer_4.quote: Since there is no gold conversation to evaluate against ... we perform human evaluation at the conversation and utterance levels... judges are asked to score each conversation on a 5‑point Likert scale. The metrics are Realism, Conciseness, Coherence, Overall naturalness. At the utterance level judges identify unsatisfactory utterances and evaluate Realism and Script‑following.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges rate dialogues on Realism, Conciseness, Coherence, and Overall naturalness using a 5‑point Likert scale; at the utterance level they label unsatisfactory utterances and assess Realism and Script‑following.
